name: IGBREIT
recent: IGBREIT 在 2026 年 11 月 5 日因基金经理费以新单位支付而发行 3,119,499 个新单位，导致大股东持股比例出现变动。公司于 10 月 30 日公布 2026 年第三季度业绩，并宣布每单位 3.51 仙的收入分配，除权日为 11 月 13 日。
notable: 发行 3,119,499 个新单位予 IGB REIT Management Sdn Bhd，作为 2026 年第三季度基金经理费的一部分。
宣布 2026 年第三季度每单位 3.51 仙的收入分配（3.45 仙应税，0.06 仙非应税）。
2026 年第三季度净利润为 RM144.15 million，同比增长 55.8%。
risks: 大股东（包括 Dato Seri Robert Tan Chung Meng 及相关实体）的持股比例因新单位发行而出现变动。
earnings: 2026 年第三季度收入为 RM249.34 million，同比增长 55.7%，环比增长 3.5%；净利润为 RM144.15 million，同比增长 55.8%，环比增长 3.5%；净利润率为 57.8%，与上一季度持平。

recent_en: IGBREIT issued 3,119,499 new units on 5 November 2026 as part of the manager's fee payment, leading to changes in substantial shareholders' holdings. The company announced its 3Q 2026 results on 30 October and declared an income distribution of 3.51 sen per unit, with ex-date on 13 November.
notable_en: Issued 3,119,499 new units to IGB REIT Management Sdn Bhd as part of the manager's fee for 3Q 2026.
Declared a 3Q 2026 income distribution of 3.51 sen per unit (3.45 sen taxable, 0.06 sen non-taxable).
3Q 2026 net profit was RM144.15 million, up 55.8% year-on-year.
risks_en: The new unit issuance results in slight dilution for existing unitholders.
Substantial shareholders' (including Dato Seri Robert Tan Chung Meng and related entities) holdings changed following the new unit issuance.
earnings_en: 3Q 2026 revenue was RM249.34 million, up 55.7% year-on-year and 3.5% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM144.15 million, up 55.8% year-on-year and 3.5% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 57.8%, unchanged from the previous quarter.
